changelog:
Initial release: Generates complete, safe, zero-downtime database migration plans with structured guidance.

- Produces thorough migration plans, not just SQL, focusing on availability and rollbacks.
- Follows and documents the expand/contract migration pattern with exact SQL and rollout steps.
- Includes detailed backward compatibility analysis and rollback/validation procedures at every phase.
- Offers a deployment runbook covering all technical and coordination steps for schema changes.
- Requires clear inputs (current/target schema, DB engine, data volume, etc.) to tailor each plan.
